versions.subject: New Rules: transformed elastic to sigma rules
versions.detection:
selection_name:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\\powershell.exe'
        - '\\pwsh.exe'
        - '\\powershell_ise.exe'
    - OriginalFilename:
        - 'powershell.exe'
        - 'pwsh.exe'
        - 'powershell_ise.exe'
selection_args_exc:
    CommandLine|contains: '-Exclusion'
selection_args_pref:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Add-MpPreference'
        - 'Set-MpPreference'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\powershell_ise.exe") OR OriginalFilename IN ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "powershell_ise.exe") CommandLine="*-Exclusion*" CommandLine IN ("*Add-MpPreference*", "*Set-MpPreference*")
